invariants.rationale: The method always returns an iterator (never null) since Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() is never null.
The singleton iterator always has one element at creation, so hasNext() must be true before any iteration.
recordMap is used to construct HoodieCreateHandle and is never modified or checked for null, so it's assumed non-null.
instantTime is passed to HoodieCreateHandle and is presumed required to be non-null.
partitionPath is passed to HoodieCreateHandle and presumed required non-null.
